game_title: Return Or Print – Firewood Stacks Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks, towering firewood stacks: the frost mage must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks: towering firewood stacks
core_gameplay_loop: In Firewood Stacks, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the frost mage ahead. Then check the court_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the frozen well by solving code steps involving court_score that move the frost mage forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the frozen well first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Or Print' (Week 6 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Firewood Stacks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
